name: Momiji Go
summary:
Step into a quiet temple garden in autumn. Maple leaves drift down, soft music plays, and across a wooden board sits Lord Tsukikage, a fox-masked master who bows before every game and reaches across the board for his stones.

Go is the world's oldest strategy game. Two players take turns placing black and white stones, each trying to surround more of the board. The rules take minutes to learn, and the game rewards a lifetime of play.
